info.title: Symplast Multimedia Public API
info.description: Authenticated public surface for patient photos, videos and documents: upload to a patient's chart, a change feed of file metadata, short-lived content links, practice albums, and file tags.

post.summary: Upload a file to a patient's chart
post.description:
**Required scope:** `multimedia.files.write`

Uploads one photo, video or document (`multipart/form-data`, at most 100 MiB) for a patient the signed-in user
can access, optionally linked to one of that patient's appointments. Images get large, medium and small
thumbnails; videos get them shortly after upload. New tag names join the practice's tag catalog; system tags
cannot be set. The file is attributed to the signed-in user and the calling App.

There is no idempotency key: a retried upload creates a second file. `sha256` is an integrity check only.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `multimedia.files.read`

Returns a cursor-paged feed of the tenant's files that the signed-in user may access. Ordered by `updatedAt`
ascending, then `id` ascending. Resume with `updatedSince` or follow `next`. `updatedAt` is the last change to the
file's metadata, at one-second resolution; every write moves a file, including tag, status and description
changes. Files in every status are included (`active`, `hidden`, `deleted`), so a consumer observes deletions.
Filter with `updatedSince` (inclusive), `patientId`, `appointmentId` and `type`.

Delivery is at-least-once across passes: dedupe on `id` keeping the highest `updatedAt`, and resume at
`updatedSince = lastSeenUpdatedAt`.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only files changed at or after this instant (inclusive), as an ISO-8601 date-time; a value with no offset is UTC. `updatedAt` has one-second resolution, so the value is floored to the whole second. To resume a sync, pass the largest `updatedAt` you have already received, or follow `next`. Omit it to start from the beginning of the feed.

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: Only files linked to this patient. Omit it for files of every patient the signed-in user may access.

parameters.name: appointmentId
parameters.description: Only files linked to this appointment. Omit it for files with or without an appointment.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only files of this type (the values `type` takes on a file). Omit it for files of every type. Case is ignored.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `multimedia.files.read`

Returns one file of the tenant that the signed-in user may access.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The file id.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `multimedia.files.read`

Returns a presigned URL for the file's `original` content (default) or, when `hasThumbnail` is true, its
`large`, `medium` or `small` thumbnail, with the time it expires. Download it without an `Authorization`
header. Request a new link rather than caching one.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The file id.

parameters.name: rendition
parameters.description: Which content to link: `original` (when omitted) or the `large`, `medium` or `small` thumbnail. Thumbnails exist only when the file's `hasThumbnail` is true. Case is ignored.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `multimedia.files.tags.write`

Adds regular tags to a file the signed-in user may access. A name matching a catalog tag (ignoring case) takes
the catalog's casing; a new name joins the practice's tag catalog; a tag the file already has is left alone.
System tags (names starting with `~`) are rejected. Returns the updated file.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The file id.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

delete.summary: Remove a tag from a file
delete.description:
**Required scope:** `multimedia.files.tags.write`

Removes one regular tag (matched ignoring case) from a file the signed-in user may access. System tags cannot
be removed. The practice's tag catalog is unchanged.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The file id.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The regular tag to remove (matched ignoring case).

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `multimedia.albums.read`

Returns a cursor-paged list of the practice's active albums. Ordered by `id` ascending, which is not
alphabetical; sort client-side for display. Follow `next` to page further. Album audiences are never returned.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The album id.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `multimedia.files.read`

Returns the files carrying ANY of the album's tag names, with the same paging, shape and per-user patient
restriction as the file feed. Ordered by `updatedAt` ascending, then `id` ascending. Follow `next` to page
further.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The album id.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `multimedia.files.read`

Returns a cursor-paged list of the practice's tag names, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive name
prefix (`search`). Ordered by the tag's internal id ascending, which is not returned, so the order is not
alphabetical; sort client-side for display. Follow `next` to page further.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Only tags whose name starts with this text, ignoring case. Omit it for every tag.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

IFormFile.description: The binary content of an uploaded file, sent as a part of a multipart/form-data request body.

data.description: The items in this page, in feed order. Empty when there are none.

pageSize.description: The page size used for this page: the requested `pageSize`, or the default.

count.description: The number of items in `data`; never more than `pageSize`.

hasMore.description: Whether another page follows. Keep paging while this is true.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, to pass as `cursor`. Null when `hasMore` is false.

next.description: Relative URL of the next page, ready to request. Null when `hasMore` is false.

PagedResponsePublicAlbum.description: One page of `PublicAlbum` items. Keep following `next` (or pass `nextCursor` as `cursor`) while `hasMore` is true.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: URI reference identifying this occurrence of the problem.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details describing an error response.

name.description: The album name. Free text, which may contain ePHI.

tagFilter.description:
The album's tag filter as stored (tag names joined with `OR` / `AND`). The public album-files route
matches files carrying ANY of the filter's tag names.

PublicAlbum.description:
A practice photo album. An album is a saved tag filter; its files are the files carrying any of its tags
(`GET /albums/{id}/files`). Audience members are never returned.

id.description: The file id (a GUID string), unique within the tenant.

fileName.description: The file name, including its extension.

status.description: The status: `active`, `hidden` (hidden from the catalog) or `deleted`.

patientId.description: The patient the file belongs to, or `null` for a file not linked to a patient.

appointmentId.description: The appointment the file belongs to, or `null`.

appointmentStartAt.description: The appointment's start (UTC), or `null` without an appointment.

tags.description: The file's regular tags. System tags are never returned.

sharedWithPatient.description: Whether the file is shared with the patient, or `null` when never set.

uploadedAt.description: When the file was uploaded (UTC), or `null` for legacy files.

uploadedByUserId.description: The Symplast user who uploaded the file, or `null` for legacy files.

originalCreatedAt.description: When the content was originally created (for example the photo's EXIF date, UTC), or `null`.

updatedAt.description:
When the file's metadata last changed (UTC, one-second resolution). This is the change-feed watermark: every write,
including tag, status and description changes, moves it.

duration.description: The duration in seconds for audio and video, or `null` when unknown.

PublicFile.description: A photo, video or document in a patient's chart. All timestamps are UTC (ISO-8601).

url.description: The presigned URL. Never log or cache it.

PublicFileLink.description:
A short-lived download link for one rendition of a file. Download it without an `Authorization` header: the URL is
presigned, and storage rejects a request carrying both.

PublicFileTagsRequest.description:
Regular tags to add to a file. Names are trimmed; a name matching a catalog tag (ignoring case) takes the catalog's
casing, and a new name joins the practice's tag catalog. System tags (names starting with `~`) are rejected.

oneOf.description: The file part. Its file name must have an extension. At most 100 MiB.

patientId.description: The patient the file belongs to (required). The signed-in user must be able to access the patient.

appointmentId.description: An appointment of that patient to link the file to.

tags.description: Regular tags. New names join the practice's tag catalog; names starting with `~` are rejected.

sharedWithPatient.description: Whether to share the file with the patient. Defaults to `false`.

originalCreatedAt.description: When the content was originally created (UTC), for example a photo's capture time.

sha256.description: The content's SHA-256 (hex). When given, a mismatch rejects the upload with `422 hash-mismatch`.

PublicFileUploadRequest.description: A `multipart/form-data` upload of one file to a patient's chart.

PublicTag.description: A tag name from the practice's tag catalog. Catalog names are free text, which may contain ePHI.

Bearer.description: Bearer access token. Send it as the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Photos and other media files in patients' charts. Sync them from the change feed, download through a short-lived link, or upload a new file to a chart.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: The practice's labels for files. List them, and add or remove them on a file.

tags.name: Albums
tags.description: Named groups of files that the practice has set up. List the albums, then list the files in one.
